preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 for N, Q, A, edges, queries in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes N is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Q <= 2 * 10**5 for N, Q, A, edges, queries in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of queries Q is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A_i <= 100 for N, Q, A, edges, queries in test_cases for A_i in A)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each node value A_i is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for N, Q, A, edges, queries in test_cases for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each edge connects nodes numbered between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for N, Q, A, edges, queries in test_cases for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each query involves distinct nodes a and b numbered between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, Q, A, edges, queries in test_cases) <= 5 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

preconditions.expression: sum(Q for N, Q, A, edges, queries in test_cases) <= 5 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of Q over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a query is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= 99 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a query is between 0 and 99.

postconditions.expression: all(result == min(abs(A[x] - A[y]) for x in S for y in S if x != y) for S, result in zip(paths, results))
postconditions.description: Each result is the minimum absolute difference between values of distinct nodes on the path S.
